description: Directed multigraph of chemical synapses in the L1 larval stage C. elegans. Each synapse is a separate unweighted edge. Multiple synapses between the same neuron pair create multi-edges. Gap junctions excluded. No autapses.
name: C. elegans L1 Larval Chemical Connectome (Witvliet 2020, Specimen 1)
